01Imperial Properties
The Apartment

A garden home in Las Adelfas

Single-level living with its own lawn, a few steps from the pools and a short walk from Port Adriano.

Offered exclusively by Imperial Properties, this ground-floor apartment sits in Las Adelfas, one of the most sought-after gated communities in Nova Santa Ponsa, with two double bedrooms and two bathrooms.

Its living room and kitchen open straight onto a private lawn, which leads on to the community gardens and pools. It is ready to move into, with scope to modernise to your own taste.

The GardenYour own lawn, level with the house
Outdoors

Indoors and out, on one level

There is no step between the living room and the grass, so the garden works as an extra room through the warmer months, and children can play in view of the kitchen.

Mature Mediterranean hedges give the lawn privacy. A gate leads onto the community's landscaped grounds, and from there it is a few steps to the two large swimming pools.

12Imperial Properties
The Location

Living like a local

Port Adriano, the Philippe Starck-designed marina, is a walk down the hill, with its restaurants, boat charters and diving centres. Three Santa Ponsa golf courses surround the neighbourhood, and the Mallorca Country Club offers tennis and padel close by.

Baleares International College is about ten minutes away by car. The Ma-1 motorway is three minutes from the gates, putting Palma about twenty minutes away.
